PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="AIRTABLE DELETE-RECORD", and $retries=0. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="AIRTABLE DELETE-RECORDS", and $retries=0. definitions.name: Airtable Delete Comment
definitions.documentation: DELETE https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}/{recordId}/comments/{commentId}. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="AIRTABLE DELETE-COMMENT", and $retries=0. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments.
